questions.q: Which of the following household articles falls under the category of 'table linen'?
options: Bedspreads and pillowcases
Tablecloths, place mats, and napkins
Bath towels and washcloths
Curtains and window blinds
questions.explain: Table linen encompasses all fabric items used to cover, decorate, or assist with dining at a table, such as tablecloths, fabric napkins, and place mats.

questions.q: If a shirt is missing a fastener, what is the appropriate clothing repair method?
options: Using a stapler to close the shirt.
Applying a fabric patch over the buttonhole.
Sewing a matching button securely back onto the garment.
Darning the collar.
questions.explain: A missing fastener, such as a button, hook, or press stud, should be repaired by using needle and thread to securely sew a matching replacement piece onto the garment.

questions.q: During the maintenance and laundering of family clothing, why is it necessary to 'sort' the clothes before washing?
options: To hide the most expensive clothes.
To group them by color, fabric type, and dirt level, preventing colors from bleeding onto white clothes.
To ensure they shrink evenly in the wash.
To waste time before the washing actually starts.
questions.explain: Sorting clothes prevents color fastness issues (where dye from a colored garment stains a white one) and allows different fabrics (like delicate silks vs. heavy jeans) to be washed at their appropriate temperatures.

questions.q: Proper clothing storage prolongs the life of a garment. How should heavily starched cotton traditional wear be stored to maintain its stiff shape?
options: Crushed and squeezed into a tight plastic bag.
Hung neatly on proper dress hangers inside a dry wardrobe.
Stored permanently in a basin of water.
Thrown on the floor in a damp corner.
questions.explain: Hanging starched clothes on hangers prevents the formation of hard wrinkles and creases, ensuring the garment retains its neat, crisp shape until the next wear.

questions.q: Which of the following household linens is specifically categorized as 'kitchen linen'?
options: Bath towel
Tea towel (Dish cloth)
Pillowcase
Window drapery
questions.explain: A tea towel or dishcloth is part of kitchen linen, used strictly in the kitchen area for drying washed dishes, wiping countertops, or handling warm pots.
